description: Open new tab at URL. Returns tab index.

wait.description: When to return: 'none' (navigation started), 'interactive' (DOMContentLoaded), 'complete' (load event fired, including subresources). Omit for the default: 'interactive' for http/https/data/blob/file, 'none' for other schemes. Use 'complete' when the page must be fully loaded, e.g. before stopping a performance recording.
